spine.claim: Bill Campbell, a former football coach, sat with the most powerful founders in tech and asked about their people, not their product.
His method was concrete: one-on-one meetings, honest feedback and a focus on the team's trust.
The hardest lesson: a brilliant founder can wreck a company, and the coach must confront him directly.
Teams that trust each other outperform teams that only chase products.
Any manager can become that coach by asking about the people in front of them.
